_comment: Library exercises that are NOT part of the PDF plan. kind=alternative (swap candidates), helper (warm-up / posture helpers), mobility (stretches). They never enter the default plan.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.description: A flat press with dumbbells that gives each arm its own path and a deeper stretch than a barbell.
cues: Kick the dumbbells up and set your shoulder blades back and down
Lower until your elbows are just below the bench
Press up and slightly in without clanging the weights
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare to 90 degrees
exercises.breathing: In on the way down, out as you press.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.description: A guided press that is easy to learn and safe to train close to failure.
cues: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back against the pad
Press until your arms are nearly straight, then return slowly
mistakes: Letting the stack rest between reps
exercises.breathing: Out as you press, in as you return.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands raised on a bench, an easier way to build pressing strength with no equipment.
cues: Hands on a bench slightly wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line
Lower your chest to the bench with elbows about 45 degrees from your torso
Press back up without letting the hips sag
mistakes: Sagging hips or a piking bum
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: A lying fly that stretches and squeezes the chest with a wide arc.
cues: Start with the dumbbells over your chest and a soft bend in the elbows
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch
Squeeze the dumbbells back together over your chest
mistakes: Straightening and bending the elbows like a press
Lowering the arms too far behind the body
exercises.breathing: In as you open, out as you close.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.description: A guided overhead press that is simple to load and easy on the stabilisers.
cues: Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height
Press straight up without shrugging
Lower slowly until your elbows are just below shoulder level
mistakes: Arching the back off the pad
exercises.breathing: Out as you press, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.description: A raise in front of the body that isolates the front delts.
cues: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of your thighs
Raise one or both arms to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend
Lower slowly without swinging
mistakes: Leaning back to lift the weight
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.description: A side raise on a low cable that keeps tension on the side delt through the whole range.
cues: Stand side-on to the low pulley and grab the handle with the far hand
Raise your arm out to shoulder height with a soft elbow
Lower slowly, keeping tension on the cable
mistakes: Leaning away to swing the weight
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
exercises.description: A bent-over raise to the sides that targets the rear delts without a machine.
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back and let the dumbbells hang
Raise your arms out to the sides with a soft elbow bend
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently and lower slowly
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
exercises.description: A two-handed overhead extension with one dumbbell that stretches the long head of the triceps.
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands and elbows pointing forward
Lower it behind your head by bending only the elbows
Extend back to the top without arching your back
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you extend.

exercises.name: Bench Dips
exercises.description: A bodyweight dip off a bench for triceps with no equipment beyond a bench.
cues: Hands on the bench behind you, legs out in front
Lower until your elbows are about 90 degrees, keeping them pointing back
Press up until your arms are straight
mistakes: Letting the shoulders roll forward and sink low
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
exercises.description: A bent-over kickback that isolates the triceps at full contraction.
cues: Hinge forward with your upper arm pinned parallel to your torso
Extend your forearm back until your arm is straight
Squeeze, then return under control
mistakes: Going too heavy and losing the squeeze
exercises.breathing: Out as you extend, in as you return.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: A row with your chest on an incline bench, which takes the lower back out of the movement.
cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with the dumbbells hanging
Row both elbows back toward your hips
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lower slowly
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad
exercises.breathing: Out as you row, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Machine Row
exercises.description: A guided seated row that is simple to load and easy to learn.
cues: Set the chest pad so your arms reach the handles fully extended
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together
Return slowly until your lats stretch
mistakes: Pulling with the hands and shrugging
Leaning back to move the weight
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you return.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.description: A bodyweight row under a bar, a great stepping stone to pull-ups.
cues: Lie under a bar set at about waist height, body in a straight line
Pull your chest up to the bar, elbows close to your body
Lower under control to full arm extension
mistakes: Pulling with a shrug and short range
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.description: A pullover that stretches and works the lats and chest through a big arc.
cues: Lie across a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest
Lower it behind your head with a slight elbow bend
Pull it back over your chest using your lats
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a triceps extension
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you pull.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: A standard alternating or double dumbbell curl with a supinated grip.
cues: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides
Curl and rotate the palms upward as you lift
Lower slowly without swinging
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: A curl on an incline bench that stretches the long head of the biceps.
cues: Sit back on a 45 degree bench with your arms hanging straight down
Curl without moving your upper arms forward
Lower to a full stretch
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.description: A curl on a low pulley that keeps constant tension on the biceps.
cues: Stand facing the low cable with your elbows at your sides
Curl the handle up to your shoulders
Lower slowly and keep the tension on
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: A squat holding one dumbbell at your chest, a beginner-friendly way to learn good squat mechanics.
cues: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with elbows down
Sit down between your knees, chest up
Drive up through your whole foot
exercises.breathing: In as you descend, out as you stand.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot on a bench, excellent for quads and glutes.
cues: Rear foot on a bench behind you, front foot far enough forward to stay balanced
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel
Drive up through the front heel
mistakes: Front foot too close, pushing the knee far forward
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you rise.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.description: A lunge that travels forward, training quads, glutes and balance together.
cues: Take a long step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor
Keep your torso upright with the front knee over the ankle
Drive through the front foot to step into the next lunge
mistakes: Short steps that push the knee past the toes
Letting the front knee cave in
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you step up.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.description: A machine squat with back support that emphasises the quads.
cues: Set your feet shoulder-width on the platform with your back flat on the pad
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel
Press up through the mid-foot without locking the knees hard
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: A hip hinge with dumbbells, an easier way to learn the Romanian deadlift.
cues: Hold the dumbbells at your thighs with soft knees
Push your hips back and slide the weights down your legs
Stand tall by driving your hips forward
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat
exercises.breathing: Brace on the way down, out as you stand.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: A floor bridge that activates the glutes and hamstrings, with no equipment.
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat
Drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top
exercises.breathing: Out as you lift, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.description: A loaded hip extension with your upper back on a bench, the best direct glute builder.
cues: Upper back on a bench with the bar across your hips (use a pad)
Drive through your heels until your hips are fully extended
Tuck your chin and squeeze your glutes at the top
mistakes: Feet too far forward or too close
exercises.breathing: Out as you thrust, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.description: A prone machine curl that isolates the hamstrings.
cues: Lie face down with the pad above your heels
Curl smoothly toward your glutes
Lower slowly without letting your hips rise
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.description: A seated raise that targets the soleus (the deeper calf muscle).
cues: Pads on your lower thighs with the balls of your feet on the platform
Rise as high as possible and pause
Lower into a deep stretch
exercises.breathing: Out as you rise, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.description: A bodyweight calf raise on one leg off a step, no machine needed.
cues: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a support
Rise as high as you can and pause
Lower into a full stretch below the step
exercises.breathing: Out as you rise, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.description: A loaded carry that builds grip, traps and trunk stability.
cues: Pick up heavy dumbbells and stand tall with shoulders down and back
Walk with short, quick steps
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning
mistakes: Letting the shoulders shrug up to the ears
exercises.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.description: A hanging raise that trains the lower abs and grip.
cues: Hang from a bar with your shoulders pulled down
Raise your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis
Lower slowly without swinging
mistakes: Using only the hip flexors with no pelvic curl
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description: A kneeling crunch on a cable that loads the abs progressively.
cues: Kneel below a high pulley holding the rope beside your head
Curl your ribs toward your pelvis, rounding the spine
Return slowly without letting the hips move
mistakes: Pulling with the arms instead of the abs
exercises.breathing: Out as you crunch, in as you return.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: A floor drill that trains the abs to hold the spine still while the limbs move.
cues: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent over your hips
Lower the opposite arm and leg while your lower back stays flat
Return and switch sides
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor
exercises.breathing: Out as you extend, in as you return.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.description: A warm-up squat with no weight, ideal for rest days and for checking your form on camera.
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width and toes slightly out
Sit down and back until your thighs are at least parallel
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and drive up through your whole foot
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you stand.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: The classic bodyweight press, used as a warm-up and as a camera form check.
cues: Hands just wider than shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows about 45 degrees from your torso
Press back up without letting the hips sag
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: A timed isometric hold that trains the whole trunk. The posture checker measures how long you hold good form.
cues: Forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders
Make a straight line from your head to your heels
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs; do not let the hips sag or pike
exercises.breathing: Breathe steadily and slowly throughout the hold.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: A simple full-body warm-up that raises your heart rate and loosens the shoulders and hips.
cues: Start standing with feet together and arms at your sides
Jump your feet apart while swinging your arms overhead
Land softly on the balls of your feet and return
exercises.breathing: Breathe rhythmically.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.description: Large controlled circles that warm up the shoulder joint.
cues: Stand tall with arms out to the sides
Make big slow circles, then reverse the direction
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears
exercises.breathing: Breathe normally.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
exercises.description: Front-to-back and side-to-side leg swings that open the hips and hamstrings.
cues: Hold a wall for balance
Swing one leg forward and back with control, gradually increasing the range
Then swing across the body and out to the side
mistakes: Swinging wildly with a rounded back
exercises.breathing: Breathe normally.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.description: Slow circles of the hips to lubricate the hip joint before squats and hinges.
cues: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and hands on your hips
Draw large smooth circles with your hips
Reverse the direction halfway
mistakes: Moving the knees instead of the hips
exercises.breathing: Breathe normally.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.description: Alternating spinal flexion and extension on all fours to wake up the back before lifting.
cues: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders
Arch your back and look up on the inhale (cow)
Round your back and tuck your chin on the exhale (cat)
exercises.breathing: Inhale into cow, exhale into cat.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.description: A lunge with a rotation that opens the hips, hamstrings, spine and shoulders in one move.
cues: Step into a deep lunge with both hands inside your front foot
Rotate your chest toward the front knee and reach that arm to the ceiling
Return and switch sides
exercises.breathing: Exhale as you rotate.

exercises.name: Thoracic Open Book
exercises.description: A side-lying rotation that frees up the upper back, which helps overhead presses and rows.
cues: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms together in front of you
Open the top arm up and over, following it with your eyes
Return slowly and repeat
exercises.breathing: Exhale as you open.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.description: Walk your hands out to a plank and back to wake up the hamstrings, shoulders and core.
cues: Stand tall, fold forward and place your hands on the floor
Walk your hands out to a straight plank
Walk your feet toward your hands and stand up
mistakes: Letting the hips sag in the plank
exercises.breathing: Breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretch for the chest and front delts after pressing days.
cues: Place your forearms on a door frame with elbows at shoulder height
Step through gently until you feel a stretch across the chest
Keep your ribs down and breathe slowly
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretch for the rear delts and upper back.
cues: Bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height
Pull it gently closer with the other hand
Keep your shoulder down, not shrugged
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretch for the long head of the triceps.
cues: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head
Press gently on the elbow with the other hand
Keep your ribs down
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Wall Biceps Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretch for the biceps and forearm flexors.
cues: Place your palm flat on a wall with your fingers pointing back and arm straight
Slowly turn your body away until you feel a stretch in the biceps
Keep your shoulder relaxed
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.description: A restful stretch for the lats, lower back and hips.
cues: Kneel and sit your hips back toward your heels
Reach your arms long in front of you
Relax your head and breathe into your back
mistakes: Forcing the hips down if the knees complain
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths into the back.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretch for the back of the thigh after leg day.
cues: Sit with one leg extended and the other foot against your inner thigh
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch
Do not bounce
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach farther
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretch for the front of the thigh.
cues: Stand on one leg holding a support and pull the other heel toward your glute
Keep your knees together and hips tucked
Stand tall without leaning forward
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretch for the hip flexors, which tighten from sitting and squatting.
cues: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg
Shift forward gently until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip
mistakes: Leaning forward instead of tucking the pelvis
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Figure-Four Glute Stretch
exercises.description: A lying stretch for the glutes and deep hip rotators.
cues: Lie on your back and cross one ankle over the opposite knee
Pull the supporting thigh toward your chest
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Calf Wall Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretch for the calves.
cues: Hands on a wall with one foot back, heel on the floor
Lean forward keeping the back leg straight
Feel the stretch in the calf; switch sides
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch
exercises.description: A gentle static stretch for the upper traps and neck.
cues: Sit or stand tall and tilt your ear toward your shoulder
Rest a hand lightly on your head for a little extra weight, without pulling
Keep the opposite shoulder down
exercises.breathing: Long slow breaths.
